channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: New town breaks ground in the Jordan Valley
item.description: A new agricultural outpost, Beitrun, was established in the Jordan Valley on Sunday, with the first structures placed on the site under the jurisdiction of the Jordan Valley Regional Council.

item.title: US Jews sour on Iran war: Just one-third now call campaign successful
item.description: JPPI Voice of the Jewish People Index finds 64% view Iran campaign as a failure, while 55% say US military action did not go far enough.

item.title: New survey: 54% of US Jews prefer Israeli opposition election victory
item.description: JPPI Voice of the Jewish People Index finds 54% prefer the current opposition, while 14% prefer the current coalition; 78% follow election news closely.

item.description: Ferry carrying 270 people capsizes off of Cyprus

item.title: Medical graduate accused of wild police chase, ramming patrol car
item.description: 29-year-old Rahat resident and medical graduate allegedly fled police on Route 77, ramming a patrol car before being stopped. An M16 rifle matching parts found in his vehicle was later recovered.

item.title: Cameras capture 15-year-old kicking kitten
item.description: Police surveillance operators identified an incident of animal abuse near the Lions’ Gate. A 15-year-old minor was arrested.

item.title: Midnight drama in Tekoa; two brothers went missing
item.description: Police forces, Search and Rescue Unit volunteers, and hundreds of residents searched throughout the night for two brothers, ages 3 and 7, from Tekoa.

item.description: The word “terrorism" requires sensitivity. Condemning Israel apparently does not... Opinion.

item.title: 80-year-old woman suffocates on giant hair tie
item.description: Doctors save the life of an elderly woman who suffered severe respiratory distress after a 15-centimeter hair tie became lodged in her esophagus, blocking more than 80% of her airway.

item.title: Yehuda Poliker woken in the night to save man threatening to jump
item.description: A Tel Aviv man said Yehuda Poliker was the only person who could convince him not to jump. Police woke the singer in the middle of the night and his intervention succeeded.

item.title: How antisemitism can advance your career
item.description: The more I understood the riotous Jewish tribe, the more I realized that a nation that can barely run the so-called "West Bank" (or, for that matter, a heated Knesset session) is unlikely to deviously pull the strings behind everything happening in the world. But never mind. Opinion.

item.title: Boy locked in his room & falls 4 stories
item.description: An 8-year-old boy fell from a height and was evacuated in serious condition with a head injury. According to initial suspicions, the boy was locked in his room on the fourth floor and tried to get out through the balcony.

item.title: “What chutzpah": Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef lashes out at Rabbi Dov Lior
item.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply attacked Rabbi Dov Lior as part of his remarks opposing visits to the Temple Mount: “He does not come up to the ankles of any of the rabbis I mentioned."

item.title: Israeli defense establishment prepares for conquest of Gaza City
item.description: As the third anniversary of the October 7 massacre approaches, the Israeli defense establishment assesses that Hamas is continuing to rebuild its military strength.

item.title: Thousands of Haredim enlist: A look at the IDF’s new service tracks
item.description: The IDF is presenting its range of dedicated tracks - from Paratroopers and Hasmonean Brigade combat soldiers to intelligence researchers and personnel in technology and logistics.

item.title: Iran’s Unit 4000 and the new architecture of outsourced terrorism
item.description: The genius-and danger-of this model is its ability to fragment an operation among people who understand only a fraction of it. Tehran’s reported covert networks use digital recruitment, criminal intermediaries, and deniable local operatives. Opinion.

item.title: Rom Braslavski responds to terrorist’s complaints to Ben Gvir
item.description: The National Security Minister visited a prison where female Palestinian Islamic Jihad terrorists are incarcerated and heard complaints about worsening conditions

item.title: Nepal: Death toll in floods rises to 734
item.description:
The Nepal Disaster Management Authority has updated that the death toll in the country's floods has risen to 734 people.
It was also reported that about 2,500 people are listed as missing.

item.title: Relief from the heat: More rain expected in north
item.description: The weather today will be partly cloudy, with localized rain expected until noon, mainly in the north of the country. Temperatures will drop further and will be lower than normal for the season, mainly in the mountains and inland.

item.title: Axios report: CIA director proposed 3-way meeting between Trump, Putin, and Zelensky
item.description:
CIA Director John Ratcliffe has proposed holding a three-way meeting between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, in an attempt to bring an end to the war in Ukraine, two sources familiar with the details told the Axios news website.
According to the report, the proposal was raised during Ratcliffe's secret visit to Moscow a few days ago.

item.title: El-Sayed courts Jewish Democrats, apologizes for comments on Michigan terror attack
item.description: Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed apologizes for controversial remarks as he works to win over skeptical Jewish Democrats ahead of November.

item.title: US Embassy: Hezbollah is taking orders from Iran, it must disarm
item.description: US Embassy in Beirut says Hezbollah must disarm, accusing the Iran-backed group of refusing talks because it is taking orders from Tehran.

item.title: Iran's President admits US sanctions are hurting the economy
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian admits US sanctions are hurting Iran's economy, days after insisting the measures would achieve nothing.

item.title: Yair Netanyahu launches scathing attack on Ben Gvir
item.description: Yair Netanyahu sharply criticizes National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir, claiming: “The police have definitively become Kaplan’s enforcement arm."

item.title: 'That crazy woman': Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef launches scathing attack on Baharav-Miara
item.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply criticizes the Attorney General over the controversy surrounding a memorial event for his father: “She is going after Maran, and this will not go unanswered."
